audit.description: Run technical design-quality checks across accessibility, performance, theming, responsive behavior, and anti-patterns. Generates a scored report with severity ratings and an actionable plan.

critique.description: Evaluate a design from a UX perspective: visual hierarchy, information architecture, emotional resonance, cognitive load, persona fit, and overall quality.

polish.description: Perform a final quality pass fixing alignment, spacing, consistency, and micro-detail issues before shipping.

harden.description: Make interfaces production-ready: error handling, i18n, text overflow, edge-case management, and resilience under real-world data.

layout.description: Improve layout, spacing, visual rhythm, alignment, density, and hierarchy.

typeset.description: Improve typography by fixing font choices, hierarchy, sizing, weight, and readability.

colorize.description: Add strategic color to monochromatic, gray, dull, or under-committed interfaces.

clarify.description: Improve unclear UX copy, labels, instructions, empty states, and error messages.

distill.description: Strip an interface to its essence by removing unnecessary complexity, noise, and redundant elements.
